approach.description: The change in a paragraph: what it does, and why this way rather than another. Not `summary`: every closeout has one, and it goes to the person who decides, never to a step.

files.description: Every path the change would touch, by path from the workspace root, each with one line on what changes in it.

path.description: The file, by path from the workspace root: one you have read, or one the change would add.

change.description: One line on what changes in it.

steps.description: The work, in order: each one a thing a second engineer could do, and check was done.

risks.description: What could go wrong, what the tests would not catch, and what you are unsure of. Empty when nothing is.
